calculation.description: Ranks tradable assets by the negative of their recent five-session return relative to the cross-sectional median, scaled by asset-specific recent volatility. Signal is lagged one completed session before evaluation.

metrics.icir_calculation: mean daily Spearman IC / std daily IC * sqrt(252)

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2026-2027 (0.035396) but near zero in 2028-2030 (0.000479); effectiveness is regime-sensitive. Five-day IC remained positive overall but decayed to 0.002871 in 2028-2030. Small cross-section requires conservative interpretation.
